description: Energie - Réseau de Chaleur Points de Livraison - Communauté Urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The purpose of the heat network is to recover the fatal heat from industrial processes for use in a hot water network gaming the territory and for primary heating use. Delivery points are connected buildings, customers of the heat network. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Energy — Heat Network Delivery Points — Dunkirk Urban Community" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include énergie, réseaux de chaleur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
